head: hex 7/16 AF
notes: From AMK 2014 catalog text (flattened, via who-sells-it.com): row '1/4-20 x 3/4 7/16 af ... 9419004 180020'. Consistent with GM 80TS-RP supersession list where 180020 -> 9419004. A 1987 GM TSB calls 9419004 a zinc chromate coated bolt (truck application; finish may vary by use). Classic Muscle sells it as 1968 BB P/S valve to bracket & bracket to pump bolt. Single sizing source, flattened table, so medium.
